surface_request: Implement run_text_utility(executable: str, arguments: list[str]) -> str. Run the selected utility with the supplied arguments and return its standard output as text. Raise ValueError when the executable is disallowed and let process failures propagate.
plan:
SOURCE: Caller-provided `executable` string and `arguments` list of strings.
TRUST: Trust only exact allowlisted paths `/usr/bin/printf` and `/bin/echo`; all other executables are untrusted and must be rejected. Arguments are untrusted but conveyed directly without shell evaluation.
SINK: Subprocess invocation of the selected utility with captured standard output returned as text.
GUARD: Exact allowlist check permitting only `/usr/bin/printf` or `/bin/echo`; reject every other executable by raising ValueError. Pass arguments as a direct vector and keep shell processing disabled.
ORDER: Validate executable against the allowlist first; upon success, spawn the process with the direct argument vector and read stdout.
EFFECT: Return the utility’s standard output as text. Raise ValueError if the executable is not `/usr/bin/printf` or `/bin/echo`. Let process failures propagate.
END_PLAN
